description: MXP retail bank rule pack: spend controls and bank-defined missions.

templates.name: Average Monthly Balance
templates.description: Average of end-of-day balances over the month, with two tiers. Paid when the month closes, because an average is only final then.
templates.summary: Hold an average monthly balance of {tier1} for {points1} points, or {tier2} for {points2} points in total.

templates.name: Average Balance Maintenance
templates.description: Keep the end-of-day balance at or above a threshold on enough days in the calendar month. Corrected snapshots for the same date replace earlier ones.
templates.summary: Keep at least {threshold} on {days} or more days this month. Earn {points} points.

templates.name: Avail an Additional Product
templates.description: Rewarded on approval only, once per product family.
templates.summary: Earn {points} points when a new {families} is approved (once per product, up to {maxProducts}).

templates.name: Merchant Category Spend Limit
templates.description: Category-specific thresholds: the customer picks the categories and the limit.
templates.summary: Keep spend on {categories} within {limit} per {period}. Earn {points} points for each {period} within it.

params.name: minActivity
params.label: Minimum spends in the period to earn

templates.name: Cross-Product Spend Diversity
templates.description: Spend through several different products in the month (credit card, debit card, UPI from savings...).
templates.summary: Spend at least {minAmount} on {distinct} different products this month. Earn {points} points.

templates.name: Dormancy Prevention
templates.description: Win back customers at risk of going dormant: transact on a few separate days this month. Target at-risk customers through the rule's eligibility.
templates.summary: Transact at least {minAmount} on {activeDays} different days this month. Earn {points} points.

templates.name: Daily Spend Limit
templates.description: Customer-configured cap on total daily spend, evaluated in real time on every transaction.
templates.summary: Keep total daily spend on {channels} within {limit}. Earn {points} points for each day you stay within it.

params.name: minActivity
params.label: Minimum transactions in the day to earn

templates.name: FD Renewal / Rollover
templates.description: Reward keeping money with the bank at maturity, in proportion to the amount renewed.
templates.summary: Renew or roll over a fixed deposit of at least {minAmount}: {pointsPer} points per {perAmount}, up to {capPerYear} points a year.

templates.name: Merchant Restrictions
templates.description: Block specific merchants entirely. Any spend at a blocked merchant is a breach.
templates.summary: No spend at {merchants}. Earn {points} points for each {period} with none.

params.name: merchants
params.label: Blocked merchants
params.description: Merchant IDs the customer wants to block.

params.name: minActivity
params.label: Minimum spends in the period to earn

templates.name: Monthly Spend Limit
templates.description: Aggregate spend cap over a calendar month or a rolling 30-day window.
templates.summary: Keep spend within {limit} per {windowType} window. Earn {points} points for each calendar month within it.

params.name: windowType
params.label: Window
params.description: MONTH = calendar month. ROLLING_DAYS = the last 30 days, re-evaluated on every transaction.

params.name: minActivity
params.label: Minimum transactions in the month to earn

templates.name: RD Timeline Completion
templates.description: Full-term milestone: the recurring deposit matures without premature closure. Paid once per RD account.
templates.summary: Complete an RD of at least {minTenure} months with no more than {maxMissed} missed installments. Earn {points} points.

templates.name: RD Payment Streak
templates.description: Consecutive on-time recurring deposit installments. A late installment or a missed month resets the streak; milestones can be earned again on a new streak.
templates.summary: Pay your RD on time every month: {m1} in a row earns {p1} points, {m2} earns {p2}, {m3} earns {p3}.

templates.name: Refer a Customer
templates.description: Rewarded on approval only. Each referral is rewarded once; a later rejection of the same referral claws the points back.
templates.summary: Earn {points} points for every referred customer whose account is approved (up to {maxPerYear} a year).

templates.name: Timing Restrictions
templates.description: Restricted hours chosen by the customer, evaluated in the customer's own timezone. Ranges may cross midnight.
templates.summary: No spend on {channels} between {from} and {to} (your local time). Earn {points} points for each {period} with none.

params.name: minActivity
params.label: Minimum spends in the period to earn

templates.name: Transaction Type Restrictions
templates.description: Block whole transaction types, for example cash withdrawals or international spends.
templates.summary: Make no transactions of these types: {blockedTypes}. Earn {points} points for each {period} with none.

params.name: minActivity
params.label: Minimum transactions in the period to earn

templates.name: UPI Transaction Count
templates.description: Genuine UPI usage, not just registration: a minimum amount, no self-transfers, and a daily cap on how many payments count.
templates.summary: Make {target} UPI payments of at least {minAmount} this month (max {maxPerDay} a day count). Earn {points} points.

rules.name: Daily Spend Limit – Mass
rules.description: Daily cap for Mass and Youth customers.
